        else:

def _parse_field(text, min_val, max_val, names):
    if not text:
        raise ValueError("Empty field")
    values = set()
    items = text.split(',')
    for item in items:
        if not item:
            raise ValueError("Empty list element")
        _parse_item(item, min_val, max_val, names, values)
    return values

def _split_fields(expr):
    stripped = expr.strip(' \t')
    if not stripped:
        raise ValueError("Empty expression")
    fields = re.split(r'[ \t]+', stripped)
    return fields

    if len(fields) != 5:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected 5 fields, got {len(fields)}")

    hours = _parse_field(fields[1], 0, 23, {})
    doms = _parse_field(fields[2], 1, 31, {})
    months = _parse_field(fields[3], 1, 12, MONTH_NAMES)

    sorted_minutes = sorted(minutes)

    # Horizon
